question: In which year did Walther Flemming coined the term 'chromatin' for the stained substance found in the cell nucleus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1879.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Walther Flemming** coined the term **'chromatin'** in the year** 1879.**
 
• Chromatin is a **complex of DNA and proteins** that forms chromosomes within the **nucleus of eukaryotic cells.**
